positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: SWE intern on the Web Core team. Developed modernized version of Facebook's WWW desktop photoviewer feedback interface and integrated feature into website. Worked with React/JS, Relay Modern, GraphQL, and PHP.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Front-end SWE intern on the Identity Account UX team. Implemented Xbox account management features and created telemetry dashboard. Worked with C#, HTML/CSS, and TS/JS/Knockout.JS.

positions.title: Computer Science Research Intern
positions.description: Conducted large-scale social network research at Hughes Research Laboratories. Research paper accepted to the ACM Web Science 2017 Conference. Produced invention disclosure.

honors.title: Tau Beta Pi Engineering Honor Society
honors.description: Tau Beta Pi candidates are selected by the Stanford School of Engineering from the top 1/8 of the junior class and top 1/5 of senior class. Initiated junior year, served as VP of Finance senior year.
honors.issuer: Issued by Tau Beta Pi · Feb 2017

volunteerExperiences.description:
* Apr 2020 - May 2020 (first offering)
* Apr 2021 - May 2021 (second offering)

Part of a teaching team for Code in Place, offered by Stanford University during the COVID-19 pandemic, with 10,000 global students and 900 volunteer teachers participating from around the world. Prepared and taught a weekly discussion section of ~10 students to supplement professors’ lectures in a 5-week introductory online Python programming course based on material from the first half of Stanford’s introductory programming course, CS106A.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Tau Beta Pi Association, Inc.
volunteerExperiences.description: Served as VP of Finance for Stanford's Engineering Honor Society Chapter. Oversaw and managed budget, secured several thousand dollars in grants and funding, tracked expenses, processed reimbursements. Worked closely with the President and VP of Operations to plan long-term strategy and vision for the Chapter.

company.name: The Tau Beta Pi Association, Inc.

projects.title: Oak Park Library Solar Panel Project
projects.description: Worked with team to collaborate with Oak Park School District, local Oak Park government, and Ventura County government to install 2.3 kilowatt solar panel system on the Oak Park Library.
